description: Your BMW's telemetry, on the command line — device-code login, live telematic snapshots, charging history, and a local SQLite store that turns raw VSS data into trends, cost, and fleet insight no other tool gives you.

tools.name: customers_create-container
tools.description: Please note that some keys are bound to dedicated endpoints. These keys can be added to a container, but the corresponding endpoint for which the container is an input-parameter (/telematicData/), won't return these keys. For further details, check the Integration Guide (chapter 3.3.2). Optional: name, purpose, technicalDescriptors. Returns array of string.

tools.name: customers_delete-container
tools.description: Delete container by ID. Required: containerId. Destructive.

params.name: containerId
params.description: ID that identifies an unique container

tools.name: customers_get-basic-data
tools.description: Request basic vehicle data for the specified vehicle. Required: vin. Returns array of string.

tools.name: customers_get-charging-history
tools.description: Request the vehicle's Charging History sessions. Required: vin, from, to. Optional: nextToken. Returns array of ChargingSessionDto.

tools.name: customers_get-container-details
tools.description: Please note that some keys are bound to dedicated endpoints. These keys can be added to a container, but the corresponding endpoint for which the container is an input-parameter (/telematicData/), won't return these keys. For further details, check the Integration Guide (chapter 3.3.2). Required: containerId. Returns array of string.

params.name: containerId
params.description: ID that identifies an unique container

tools.name: customers_get-image
tools.description: Request a vehicle image for the specified vehicle. Required: vin.

tools.name: customers_get-location-based-charging-settings
tools.description: Request Vehicle's location based charging settings. Required: vin. Optional: nextToken. Returns array of LocationBasedChargingSettingsDataDto.

tools.name: customers_get-mappings
tools.description: Request mapped vehicles. Returns the VehicleMappingDto.

tools.name: customers_get-smart-maintenance-tyre-diagnosis
tools.description: Request a vehicle Smart Maintenance Tyre Diagnosis for the specified vehicle. Required: vin. Returns array of SmartMaintenanceErrorDto.

tools.name: customers_get-telematic-data
tools.description: Please note that some keys are bound to dedicated endpoints. These keys can be added to a container, but the corresponding endpoint for which the container is an input-parameter (/telematicData/), won't return these keys. For further details, check the Integration Guide (chapter 3.3.2). Required: vin, containerId. Returns the ExVeTelematicDataResponseDto.

tools.name: customers_list-containers
tools.description: List the containers. Returns array of ContainerDto.
